root_cause.text: A deadlock occurs when `mt7925_roc_abort_sync()` calls `cancel_work_sync()` while holding `dev->mt76.mutex`, because the work function `roc_work()` also acquires the same mutex, causing mutual waiting.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that "roc_work() holds dev->mt76.mutex, while cancel_work_sync() waits for roc_work() to finish. If the caller already owns the same mutex, both sides block." The patch replaces `cancel_work_sync()` with the non-blocking `cancel_work()` and adds an early return check to prevent the deadlock.
